result.keyword: What's the best HR software for a small company?
result.markdown:
For most small companies, **I'd recommend Gusto if you want payroll and HR together, or BambooHR if your main priority is managing employees and HR processes.**

The best choice depends on your company size, whether you have hourly or salaried employees, and how much HR administration you want to automate.

Here are my top recommendations for 2026.

## Best HR software for small businesses

![Gusto Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ftD0qJ1yBSoWTtDEs2sOfDQ7-65e7zEzHy-HIAb3bqFrmNGGc0DyUX0E7CdY1ulVg_3Q5_8qLVi4LE1wqaQS_JVEpU9pxbwM6Kz6OYgPCcQM2vYw21WPy-MCNW4IYnmmdNSrLtuLoIyJLYtPy5hO5B7jEV7698TKyyKP6yzFWMR7Sgf2P81H8Y7V-Tx23IPn?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Gusto**

(Best overall for small businesses)

Starting around \$49/month + \$6/employee/month

- Payroll and automatic tax filings
- Employee onboarding and documentation
- Benefits administration
- PTO and time tracking

Best for companies that want payroll, benefits, and basic HR in one platform.

[Gusto website](https://gusto.com/)

---

![BambooHR Pricing Tiers & Costs (Updated for 2026)](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/lfGhQCVpJQbVf41B3vtRX6UWHPJMlOVTkV5Lya9yPIISkiwns_htURwqMmTW1XKVeOlzwGtSwMoAy6xHZfLSsDRbj_k8ukNFpuVVacxjpUmUJ8OulZgM7uKaXXq0t7AgyNBI0lwdAtl5FOEEJtWnohYZhANModEpYKzGNdOVx23nOO8vpFEk1sa8a024E67p?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BambooHR**

(Best dedicated HR platform)

Pricing varies; small-company plans can start around \$250/month

- Employee records and personnel management
- Hiring and onboarding
- Performance reviews
- PTO management and reporting

Best for companies that want a professional HR department system without unnecessary complexity.

[BambooHR website](https://www.bamboohr.com/)

---

![#1 Workforce Management System - Gong Collective](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/6qeGsApk2jIdFyoxTSygvm7DexVcRwsdAMy-654nhQtsS9qblmlI3_rlyRsZYYkAZppbxudJa7sWDHqPbmVa4ApGBm0HQ-Ug4zK3bKSWGz9BUa-Xw79ufdKKevGKKSwz6wXnJf7tmhQAv7jp_2IhhmpGMf4r2A4gxIyk--T1g2YbjSd8UAKymDETIYyyT6m-?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Rippling**

Starting around \$8/employee/month plus base fees; configuration dependent

- HR, payroll, and benefits
- Employee onboarding automation
- Software and device management
- Advanced workflow automation

Best for growing companies that want to automate many business processes.

[Rippling website](https://www.rippling.com/)

---

![Introducing Zoho People 5.0 | Streamlined & secure HR software](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/N2tyoCYDXo_2X8HD_5-SWCfDBpBrfnJxvS27zq0luRDcSBxvb5ksF8GIcSrns-PjyFB81AcM6r9iE-CSXiUONYeUFYVq66I46rVVwsJXPLlWkRDDpj17x51dneUMDGMOeIbB1fDSAq7EtcK5moqwY1sb0xYonWwdnsoigFpIV0zzd1uQR8FzhmzsLBPdP8qA?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Zoho People**

Free tier available; paid plans from around \$1.50/user/month

- Employee database
- Leave and attendance management
- Employee self-service
- Performance management

Best for smaller businesses looking to keep costs down.

[Zoho People website](https://www.zoho.com/people/)

---

![Homebase Reviews | Read Customer Service Reviews of joinhomebase.com](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/ONPs31_XAP2XsJBs3Eie1qwgyuurZU2xtkB45n63IU2mOmCOoAYejKgqUNvwLJpQL-m8_ulLsnIwjUgfiI4WF5j-tZkBh8f6GZwUhD2ecILOo9YLaThDdn8foDqSv6GukdJX7e1Y6DGttWLJtIJKBrbS-cL872eVJQ2r8lUE_O-eo573PPEMZiZEhnAyfs0F?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Homebase**

Free basic plan; paid plans available

- Employee scheduling
- Time clocks and attendance
- Timesheets
- Team communication

Best for restaurants, retail, hospitality, and hourly employees.

[Homebase website](https://www.joinhomebase.com/)

## Quick comparison

| Software | Best use | My verdict |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Gusto | Payroll + HR | Best for most small businesses |
| BambooHR | Full HR management | Best HR-focused solution |
| Rippling | Automation + growth | Best for scaling |
| Zoho People | Budget-friendly HR | Best low-cost option |
| Homebase | Hourly workforce | Best for scheduling |
